originalSourceProvenance.evidence: Original source was read directly in tool outputs before the reviewer sent findings to the parent. Parent was explicitly told it could start one consolidated repair.
originalSourceProvenance.limitation: Original full-file SHA/immutable source copy was not captured before authorized concurrent repair. Original line references and source observations are historical tool-read evidence, not a hash-bound approval of the current working files. No hash is reconstructed or invented.

findings.title: Neutral fault can drift into the second real input sequence
findings.issue: Original macro was focus, real40ms balanced click,wait30,and a second real balanced click. GET/ps/snapshot work before kill had no monotonic deadline. A final neutral sample could be followed by suffix down and then root SIGKILL, producing an unarmed held fault.
findings.requiredChange: Remove future input from this neutral calibration. Use the agreed wait-only macro and a monotonic stream-start-to-fault deadline below15s, plus a final pending/no-result and exact birth check; late/finished means no injected fault.

findings.title: Failure cleanup could interrupt input before neutral completion was known
findings.issue: Errors before completed-prefix proof entered finally and killOwnTree(server), potentially inside the40ms pair. Receiver was then closed. This adds a hard input fault even if planned fault preconditions were never reached.
findings.requiredChange: Wait-only zero-input rewrite removes this mechanism. Future input cases need separately reviewed settlement/neutral-aware cleanup and must preserve observer/identities rather than force unknown held input; no recovery input is authorized by this calibration.

findings.title: Dead root skipped original survivor cleanup
findings.issue: After root-only SIGKILL, gone(rows) timeout leaves guardian/ACC/native survivors. stopOwned returns immediately for an exited root and does not handle retained original identities.
findings.requiredChange: Retain original born rows; classify product observation as failed before any separate exact PID+birth survivor cleanup. Never walk an exited/reused root, blanket-kill by name/group, or credit external cleanup as product automatic exit.

findings.title: Topology strings did not prove numeric independent group ownership
findings.issue: PGID was only part of a command string; substring matches did not check numeric guardian/primary/ACC/native chain, receiver group exclusion or command/birth coherence.
findings.requiredChange: Record numeric PID/PPID/PGID/SID with command observations bracketed by consistent births. Prove bound root→guardian→primary→ACC→native chain and receiver outside supervised groups. Receiver can share external root/runner PGID; do not incorrectly require its PGID differ from root.

findings.title: Input receipt source, point and timing were not attributed
findings.issue: Receiver one down/up plus ACC success could be accepted without checking recorded sourcePID/coordinates/timing against the actual native worker and expected point.
findings.requiredChange: Wait-only removes input attribution by requiring zero counts/receipts. If input is later reintroduced, qualify actual sourcePID support, matching native birth and point/time; absent reliable attribution is inconclusive, not a made-up nonce or held gate pass.

findings.title: JSON key order comparison and incomplete final-state preflight
findings.issue: JSON.stringify of NSDictionary-derived frame/input_source can reject equal values due to key order. Final state only checked neutral/counts, omitting prior geometry/frontmost/source/otherInput conditions.
findings.requiredChange: Compare fixed finite frame fields and explicit source id/type; recheck exact owner/stationary/focus/source/no-input conditions at final fault preflight. In wait-only require counts0 and empty receipts throughout.

findings.title: Original crash evidence omitted Node logs and discarded service output
findings.issue: Snapshots copied sessions/ACC logs only; service stdout/stderr was resumed and discarded. Late cleanup/archive failures could bypass the final result writer, weakening crash/restart evidence.
findings.requiredChange: Retain isolated Node logs, per-generation raw service outputs, and guarded terminal failure/incomplete evidence. Mark cross-file snapshots non-atomic; do not manufacture missing persisted macro/cleanup receipts.

acceptedFollowupDirection.decision: Parent chose the narrower plan step2 wait-only macro, zero input_sequence/focus mutation steps, actual list_windows for worker existence, zero-input neutral receiver, root-only SIGKILL and GET-only restart.
acceptedFollowupDirection.reviewStatus: Final revised sources are to receive a separate full v2 review; no closure or runtime pass inferred by this historical report.

scope: Source-only review of original neutral balanced-prefix candidate; no GUI, test, compilation, snapshot process tool, signature, signal, input or runtime probe performed by reviewer. This is not held-state/rescue/TCC/lock/clipboard/App/Windows or whole-P5 acceptance.
